subject: religious-studies
title: Shahada and Salah
welcome_lead: Discover the first two pillars of Islam: faith and prayer.
meta_desc: KS3 Religious Studies adventure on Shahada and Salah, two Pillars of Islam.
final_note: You can now explain the first two Pillars of Islam.

concepts.def: Five core duties of every Muslim.
Declaration: there is no god but Allah; Muhammad is his messenger.
Washing before prayer to be clean.

walkthroughs.body_html: The Shahada is the first Pillar. It is the Muslim statement of faith: 'There is no god but Allah, and Muhammad is the messenger of Allah.' Saying and believing this sincerely makes someone a Muslim.

Salah is the second Pillar — five daily prayers at set times: dawn, midday, afternoon, sunset and night. Muslims face Mecca (the qibla), perform set movements, and recite verses from the Quran in Arabic.

Before prayer, Muslims perform wudu — washing the hands, mouth, face, arms and feet. This shows respect to God and helps focus the mind. The adhan (call to prayer) is often given from the mosque's minaret.
